minimum_evidence_set.kind: One logical evidence submission, not necessarily one source artifact

mandatory_components.requires: Competently authenticated current source/target facts, governing checks and trusted current checkpoint; referenced evidence bytes must be supplied or explicitly admitted for bounded reading.
Existing authenticated rule/decision, competence/effectivity and explicit application to exact target with exclusions.

minimum_evidence_set.coalescence: A single existing authoritative record may cover both components and all eight rows only if its owner is competent for every assertion, all authentication/identity/currentness and derivation requirements are met, and each proof is explicit. Otherwise supply independently authoritative supporting records; a wrapper cannot combine authority domains by declaration.
minimum_evidence_set.minimality_limit: One logical submission is the minimum packaging request; no globally minimum physical artifact count can be proven from unknown producers/source formats. Two irreducible proof components may share bytes; all eight propositions remain independent.

entry_requirements: Concrete evidence submission exists with gate/target identifiers, exact bounded file/byte manifest and claimed coverage.
User/authorized delivery admits receipt of exact bytes; external fetches require explicit bounded source/transport authorization.
Existing trust anchors and governing identity/validation rules are available; missing anchors block, not self-authenticate.

required_members: artifact manifest: locator or inline bytes, raw content hash, declared identity and identity rule
producer identity/domain and existing competence proof references
per-obligation claim with evidence IDs, precise source pointers and explicit governing derivation
snapshot/generation and governing freshness rule with trusted current anchor
submission_contract.format: Exchange metadata only. No new authority record schema imposed; original source bytes and original canonical identity rules must remain intact.

validation_steps: Freeze exact receipt bytes and source identities; reject ambiguous parsing/duplicate keys or identity/type confusion.
Authenticate every necessary producer/competence chain under existing trusted rules, independently recompute identities and reject digest substitutions.
Check exact subject, source/target phase, lineage, runtime/store/profile bindings and coherent snapshot/current anchor.
Evaluate each of eight propositions separately using explicit governing derivations only; record PROVED, DISPROVED, EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND, AUTHORITY_DECISION_REQUIRED or EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
Persist supported observations and provenance; no authority inference, evidence repair or silent fill-in. Negative evidence is retained without authorizing use.
Emit content-addressed validation receipt and proof matrix; only accepted full current positive coverage enables the bounded FACT revalidation attempt.

outcomes.ACCEPTED_COMPLETE: All required positive proofs accepted; schedule FACT-BUDGET-APPLICABILITY revalidation, do not execute it automatically.
outcomes.ACCEPTED_PARTIAL: Retain only proved observations; keep remaining external gate, no full reentry.
outcomes.NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE: Preserve authenticated incompatibility/staleness against named proposition; gate not satisfied, REEVAL remains blocked.
outcomes.REJECTED: Malformed/untrusted/inapplicable/stale-as-positive or contradictory input cannot establish applicability. Preserve rejection provenance; do not repair.
outcomes.AUTHORITY_BRANCH: Technical evidence complete but no governing applicability rule: record separate decision-input requirement, not permission or a ready decision.

receipt_action.assertion_rule: Assertion must retain source artifact path/content identity, source field, subject/generation, extraction and validation method, and authentic producer/rule provenance. Dossier/request/receipt existence alone is not a substantive graph assertion.
receipt_action.staleness: Changed source, governing rule, relevant current generation or target invalidates dependent positive assertions until independently revalidated; no arbitrary TTL is invented.

Exact submitted bytes and source manifest recorded; no acceptance implied.

generic_rule_gap: Existing plan has an external hold and fact-revalidation rule, but lacks complete request/delivery/receipt/validation states. This artifact specifies that lifecycle only for the budget gate; no unrelated gates or planner implementation are changed.
reentry_route: REEVAL-BUDGET new attempt only on accepted full proof
control_boundary: No received evidence and no internal actionable work. Stop reasoning/execution; resume on explicit new evidence/control input. Request not sent; receipt not executed. This artifact records the formal waiting disposition; existing planner state remains untouched.
historical_outcome: FACT-BUDGET-APPLICABILITY attempt finished with EXTERNAL_GATE_REQUIRED; it remains BLOCKED, not successfully COMPLETED, in the action ledger.
